// vagabonds - the library has to load before anything that uses it.
//loadmod old example options.mod.gml

/loadmod teloader
/loadmod fake crowns.mod.gml
/load custom options
/loadwep Weapons/KirbyWeps/kirby.wep
/loadskin Fish in wheelchair
/loadskin skins/fish-hawaiian/hawaiian
/loadrace baldi.race
/loadcrown Crowns/crwn_vagabond
/loadskill ColdSnap/coldsnap.skill
/wep Weapons/KirbyWeps/kirby.wep
/loadlive library/live.mod.gml
	/allowmod teloader.mod
/unloadmod teloader.mod
/silencemod library
/ignoremod library
/savemod teloader teloader.copy.mod.gml
/timeout 600
/gml some_call(1)
/gmlapi

// Ordinary chat commands: /load runs these from a command file too.
/wscale 2
/colour red
/cwep2 revolver

// A typo the grammar cannot resolve.
/lodmod typo.mod.gml

// /loadtext loads a command file too; the FAQ lists it under /load, the
// binary's alias table does not.
/loadtext main2.txt
